instruction.description: Freeform instruction for the Specialist (e.g. distilled plan)

work_dir.description: Run the endpoint against this checkout instead of the session workspace. Must be the root of a linked git worktree of the workspace repo — create one under .booley/worktrees/ with `booley worktree new <name>`. Omit to use the current workspace.

base.description: Review only the --scope files changed since the merge-base of COMMIT and HEAD, uncommitted changes included; problems already present before the change are reported as non-blocking pre-existing observations

dry_run.description: Validate inputs and preview planned work without invoking Specialists or EDA tools

fail_on.description: Exit with failure when an open finding is at or above this severity; without it a completed review exits 0.

focus.description: Review focus category. RTL: bugs, code_style, optimization, protocol, security, spec. TB: quality.

spec.description: Path to the specification the review checks. Required for spec-focused reviews unless --spec-text is given; pass the Project specification path.

spec_text.description: Specification text the review checks, instead of a --spec file.

steer.description: Developer Agent context and steering instructions. Repeatable; over MCP pass an array of strings, not a bare string.
